dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D narrowing from the widest mid-body section toward a sharp posterior point.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Minor asymmetrical outward bulge on the mid-left lateral margin; right lateral margin is predominantly linear.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity normalized pixel baseline across the entire visible dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Single, faint longitudinal linear mark visible on the anterior-right dorsal quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: One faint, thin vertical scar or rake mark on the upper right side of the body.
